theme: A clear day at sea before the crossing home.
greeting: The girls are with Jen and the calendar is nearly empty, Dan — just the NACD programming call bridging the afternoon. The charter runs to Saturday, so the week's real work is locking down the Cavtat transfers and the Florida landing.

needsAttention.title: Charter ends Saturday — transfers still open
needsAttention.detail: The Cavtat hotel is booked, but the Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer, the bag hold before 3 PM check-in, and the ~5:15 AM checkout for the 7:30 flight all still need arranging from shore before charter connectivity drops.

needsAttention.title: St Pete Airbnb locks in Sept 18
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27 - Oct 5 St Pete booking charges the 18th. It's the last window to switch to a better rate or location before it's paid and switching costs more.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The Pathfinder heads south in October, so Christmas in Maine needs a full-size SUV out of Portland - the hardest rental in that market over the holiday. Hold a refundable one now while inventory lasts.

inbox.noise: Two-plus days of newsletters and shop promotions - Foreign Affairs, NYT Cooking, sailing schools, Maine seafood, furniture finds.
inbox.clear: Nothing is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Apple galette
recipe.why: Autumn brings the first crisp apples, ideal for a rustic free-form tart.

tasks.title: Book Sept 20 - Oct 5 SUV at TPA (land Sun 3:55 PM)
Book St Pete lodging for the Sept 20-22 landing gap
Buy Disney tickets - Orlando Sept 26-27, all six

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar before midday - the morning belongs to the boat.
One hour for the NACD New England programming committee on Zoom, then the day reopens.
Clear ahead - Saturday's disembarkation at Komolac and the flight home are the next fixed points.
